notes: Fixed platform scale {0, 8, 16, 20, 40, 60}, same reasoning shape as Asana Connector (0/8/16 tiers) and MuleSoft Connector (40/60 tiers), 2026-08-20/21. 0 = access setup (connect_hubspot, disconnect_hubspot, list_connections -- not a HubSpot API operation against portal data). 8 = any single-portal read (list_*/get_*/search_objects/batch_read_objects/sync_check). 16 = standard single write/CRUD action on one record or one link (create/update/archive a CRM record of any type, associate/remove an association, create a property, log/update one engagement, add/remove list membership, upload one file, define one custom object schema, one webhook subscription action). 40 = aggregated value-add reports that scan across the whole portal/pipeline, not a single record (get_pipeline_health, find_duplicate_contacts) -- same tier as MuleSoft's audit_cloudhub_environment/get_stale_applications. 60 = bulk operations touching up to 100 records in one call (batch_create_objects, batch_update_objects, batch_archive_objects, bulk_update_deal_stage) -- same tier as MuleSoft's bulk_* application tools. No Google Cloud markup applies (HubSpot is not a Google-backed API). revenue_split_dev=95 (partner tier, consistent with Asana/MuleSoft/Workato pricing set the same period).
